The look / No-makeup

Dewy Fresh

A hydrated, barely-there glow with a tinted lip.

Shop this look

About this look

Dewy Fresh is the no-makeup makeup look: hydrated skin, groomed brows, a hint of flush and a soft tinted lip that looks like your own, only brighter.

The direction

  • Hydrated, glass-like skin
  • Groomed, feathered brows
  • A soft tinted lip

How to recreate it

  1. Hydrate and even with a sheer skin tint only where needed.
  2. Brush the brows upward for a groomed finish.
  3. Dab a cream blush high on the cheek.
  4. Press a lip tint onto the centre of the lips and blend.
